name: Anastesia Lawes
original_name: アナステシア・ローズ
source: The british transfer student who grew up in Japan, she is very outgoing and can talk to anybody. She is familiar with the Japanese culture, but most her knowledge is taken from hentai doujins, especially ones with bukkakes.
